svg.title: Part 2 Agent Workflow — MCP Required
svg.desc: Seven-stage agent workflow showing bounded agents, required MCP tool calls, verified artifact handoffs, and fail-closed behavior.
svg.text: Bounded agents sequence verified files; deterministic processing stays behind MCP
SKILLS = scientific policy + MCP sequencing | no processing scripts
BOUNDED AGENTS — orchestrator advances only verified hand-offs
Agents judge and gate; they never pass voxel arrays through context
MCP TOOL BOUNDARY — compact structured results + artifact paths
VERIFIED FILE HAND-OFFS — hashes, schema versions, lifecycle state, config provenance
FAIL-CLOSED: unavailable or schema-incompatible MCP -> stop and report dependency
configure or restart client — never use a script, direct import, or improvised fallback
